detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This pack unlocks 11 new creatures to have as a pet on ICARUS, as well as loot and trophies from them:
  • 5 new Cats
  • 7 new Dogs
  • 3 new Horses

How to access your companions in game

Animal Companions are purchased from the workshop space and brought down to planet. Once deployed they become a regular tamed animal, with their own levels, talent tree and food / water requirements.
